01-stacked-revenue-cagr.stresses: baseline: 4 series, CAGR arrow row with date-derived years, right-hand series labels, thin top segments

02-stacked-quarters-thin.stresses: 8 quarters x 5 series, sub-1% segments (outside labels with leaders, stagger), quarterly dates, difference arrow

03-stacked-negatives.stresses: negative segments stacked below the baseline, net totals that are negative, value axis

08-line-nulls.stresses: 12 months x 3 series with nulls (broken lines), sparse labelling (last point only), month axis

09-line-crossing-zero.stresses: single series crossing zero: dashed zero line, labels on the right side of the slope

10-combo-plan-line.stresses: stacked columns + a line on the same axis: line labels and totals compete for the space above the columns

11-waterfall-subtotals.stresses: EBITDA bridge with two computed subtotals ("e"), connectors, positive/negative colours

12-waterfall-build-down.stresses: build-down from a large total with a value axis and grouped thousands (1,250m)

13-waterfall-cross-zero.stresses: steps crossing the baseline, the running sum below zero, 0.2-0.3 steps labelled outside

14-mekko-market-map.stresses: 6 x 5 percent Mekko with an Other series, a 2% column whose labels go outside with leaders

16-pie-small-slices.stresses: 7 slices with four under 3%: inside -> outside labels with leaders spread on one side

17-doughnut-total.stresses: doughnut with the grand total in the hole and value + share labels

22-area100-mix.stresses: 100% area: shares rounded per category, thin top band

23-harvey-vendors.stresses: Harvey balls 4 x 6 with long criteria names in the header

25-gantt-programme.stresses: Gantt with milestones, a today line, a shaded period and two brackets
